name: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Administrative and remote access to production systems requires a second authentication factor.
notes: Enforced for the customer portal administration console but not for the identity provider administrator role.

name: Least Privilege Access
description: Accounts and service identities are granted only the permissions required for their function, and access is reviewed periodically.
notes: Human accounts are reviewed quarterly. Service account privileges have not been reviewed in the current period.

name: Password Policy
description: A documented password policy defines minimum length, complexity, reuse restrictions, and rotation requirements.
notes: A policy document exists but the enforced technical settings are weaker than the documented requirement.

name: Asset Inventory
description: An inventory of systems, services, and their owners is maintained and kept current.
notes: Production assets are recorded. Development and staging services are recorded inconsistently.

name: Centralized Log Collection
description: Security-relevant logs from production systems are forwarded to a central location and retained for a defined period.
notes: Logs remain on individual hosts. No central collector is configured.

name: Log Review and Alerting
description: Collected logs are reviewed and alerting rules exist for defined security events.
notes: Dependent on LM-01. No alerting rules are currently defined.

name: Dependency and Patch Management
description: Third-party dependencies and operating system packages are tracked and updated on a defined schedule.
notes: Dependency inventory is generated during builds, but there is no documented remediation timeline.

name: Secure Configuration Baseline
description: Systems and application components are configured against a documented secure baseline before release.
notes: A baseline exists for server images. Application-level settings such as upload handling are not covered.

name: Incident Response Plan
description: A documented incident response procedure defines roles, escalation paths, communication steps, and post-incident review.
notes: Only an outline draft exists. Roles and escalation paths are undefined.

name: Data Backup and Restore
description: Critical data is backed up on a defined schedule and restore procedures are tested periodically.
notes: Backups run nightly. The last documented restore test did not cover the primary application database.

name: Data Classification and Handling
description: Data is classified by sensitivity and handling requirements are defined for each classification level.
notes: A draft policy was supplied but has not been reviewed in this assessment period.

name: Security Awareness Training
description: Staff complete security awareness training on joining and at least annually thereafter.
notes: Training is assigned to all staff. Completion tracking shows a significant number of outstanding records.
